mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diets ( user_id, nutrition_id, diet_date, meal_type, meal_time, amount, note, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{nutritionId}, #{dietDate}, #{mealType}, #{mealTime}, #{amount}, #{note}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: WITH DietSummaries AS ( SELECT d.diet_date as summaryDate, SUM(CASE WHEN d.meal_type = 'BREAKFAST' THEN n.calories * d.amount ELSE 0 END) as breakfastCalories, SUM(CASE WHEN d.meal_type = 'LUNCH' THEN n.calories * d.amount ELSE 0 END) as lunchCalories, SUM(CASE WHEN d.meal_type = 'DINNER' THEN n.calories * d.amount ELSE 0 END) as dinnerCalories, SUM(n.calories * d.amount) as totalCalories, SUM(n.protein * d.amount) as totalProtein, SUM(n.fat * d.amount) as totalFat, SUM(n.carbohydrates * d.amount) as totalCarbohydrates FROM diets d JOIN nutrition n ON d.nutrition_id = n.id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.diet_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY d.diet_date ), BreakfastDiets AS ( SELECT d.diet_date, JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'id', d.id, 'nutritionId', d.nutrition_id, 'amount', d.amount, 'note', d.note, 'mealTime', d.meal_time ) ) as breakfast FROM diets d WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.meal_type = 'BREAKFAST' AND d.diet_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY d.diet_date ), LunchDiets AS ( SELECT d.diet_date, JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'id', d.id, 'nutritionId', d.nutrition_id, 'amount', d.amount, 'note', d.note, 'mealTime', d.meal_time ) ) as lunch FROM diets d WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.meal_type = 'LUNCH' AND d.diet_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY d.diet_date ), DinnerDiets AS ( SELECT d.diet_date, JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'id', d.id, 'nutritionId', d.nutrition_id, 'amount', d.amount, 'note', d.note, 'mealTime', d.meal_time ) ) as dinner FROM diets d WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.meal_type = 'DINNER' AND d.diet_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY d.diet_date ) SELECT ds.*, bd.breakfast, ld.lunch, dd.dinner FROM DietSummaries ds LEFT JOIN BreakfastDiets bd ON ds.summaryDate = bd.diet_date LEFT JOIN LunchDiets ld ON ds.summaryDate = ld.diet_date LEFT JOIN DinnerDiets dd ON ds.summaryDate = dd.diet_date ORDER BY ds.summaryDate DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE diets SET amount = #{amount}, note = #{note}, meal_type = #{mealType}, meal_time = #{mealTime}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id as userId, nutrition_id as nutritionId, diet_date as dietDate, meal_type as mealType, meal_time as mealTime, amount, note, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM diets WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND diet_date = #{date} ORDER BY meal_type, id
